<!-- gate-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the gate catalog and the checker's spec; edit those, not this block -->

A change to a frozen part is told, with the freeze's reason; it informs and never bars.

| Propriedade | Valor |
| --- | --- |
| Verificação | `frozen-touched` |
| Confronta | `spec` `product` `feature` `code` `test` |
| Bloqueante por padrão — projeto novo | sim |
| Bloqueante por padrão — projeto existente | não — informa |

## Como declarar

```yaml
gates:
  - name: frozen-touched
    on: [spec, product, feature, code, test]
    check: frozen-touched
```

Fonte: [verificação](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/frozen.go) · [sua spec (em inglês)](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/frozen.spec.md)
